t: 爱德华·巴利奥尔向爱德华三世交出自己对苏格兰王位的主张来换取英国的养老金.
te: Edward Balliol surrenders his claim to the Scottish throne to Edward III in exchange for an English pension.
dz: 爱德华·巴利奥尔向爱德华三世交出自己对苏格兰王位的主张来换取英国的养老金.
de: Edward Balliol surrenders his claim to the Scottish throne to Edward III in exchange for an English pension.

t: 普瓦提耶斯战役(Battle of Poitiers):由"黑王子"爱德华所指挥的一支英格兰军…
te: An English army under the command of Edward the Black Prince defeats a French army and captures King John II.
dz: 普瓦提耶斯战役(Battle of Poitiers):由"黑王子"爱德华所指挥的一支英格兰军队击败了一支法国军队并俘虏了国王约翰二世.
de: Battle of Poitiers: An English army under the command of Edward the Black Prince defeats a French army and captures King John II.

t: 巴塞尔地震是阿尔卑斯山以北最有历史意义的地震事件,它摧毁了瑞士巴塞尔市镇.
te: Basel earthquake, the most significant historic seismological event north of the Alps, destroys the town of Basel, Swit…
dz: 巴塞尔地震是阿尔卑斯山以北最有历史意义的地震事件,它摧毁了瑞士巴塞尔市镇.
de: Basel earthquake, the most significant historic seismological event north of the Alps, destroys the town of Basel, Switzerland.

t: 神圣罗马皇帝查理四世颁布"金牛",为他的帝国制定宪法.
te: Charles IV, Holy Roman Emperor, promulgates the Golden Bull, a constitution for his empire.
dz: 神圣罗马皇帝查理四世颁布"金牛",为他的帝国制定宪法.
de: Charles IV, Holy Roman Emperor, promulgates the Golden Bull, a constitution for his empire.
